messages:
maria_r: quick follow-up on continuous-batcher RFC. want to finalize the admission shim surface + operator escape hatches before i start the prototype.
akash_k: good timing. what are the non-negotiables for v1?
maria_r: minimal set: classification->queue_tag, return opaque slot_token, provide an expected_wait_ms_est. v1 must be telemetry-only by default, with a tiny probabilistic canary routing flag. no heavy routing logic yet.
linh_t: workers should ignore slot_token until we enable warmups, right?
maria_r: exactly. workers treat slot_token as optional. when canary enabled, workers may call KV.Pin(slot_token). missing token -> mark exec as cold.
sam_sre: ops requirements: prometheus metrics + per-queue kill-switch. metrics we need: admission_enqueues_total{queue_tag,model,tenant}, admission_rejects_total{reason}, worker_execs_total{model,queue_tag,exec_cold}, warmup_attempts_total, warmup_dropped_total, queue_circuit_tripped_total. add alerts for warmup surge and fastpath cost delta.
devops_j: feature flags per-region/pool and a global kill-switch that forces legacy routing. dashboards with synthetic tiny-vs-stream tests required before ramp.
akash_k: routing knobs idea: base_prob + surge_prob. surge_prob kicks in when queue growth rate > threshold. also add smoothing window to avoid oscillation.
linh_t: warmup dedupe: local in-memory dedupe keyed by (model,queue_tag,slot_prefix) with ~200ms TTL. cap warmup concurrency per-GPU so warmups don't thrash.
maria_r: implementation note: slot_token stays opaque externally, but internal format can be versioned. workers must not rely on parsing; they only hand token to KV manager. docs must forbid client-side parsing.
sam_sre: failure modes: lost slot_token mid-dispatch -> treat as cold-exec; increment slot_token_loss_total. SLA target <0.1%. document this clearly in runbook.
akash_k: perf constraint: admission shim path must be nano/micro-second scale. plan: implement hotpath in Rust/C++ and expose a shared-memory view for workers to read queue_tag/state cheaply. fallback RPC if shm not present.
maria_r: rollout plan: (1) FF telemetry-only 72h, (2) 1% probabilistic tagging in staging with harness, (3) enable slot_token warmups for canary tenants, (4) enable circuit-breaker + fastpath ramp. each step has explicit rollback.
linh_t: preemption? skip hard preempt API in v1. we rely on DrainHint/early-flush opt-in and instrument drain_hints_emitted_total for visibility. revisit in v2.
devops_j: rollback playbook: flip ff/queue-ecosystem-v1 off per-region -> legacy shaper. if queues don't drain in 5m, escalate and restart worker fleet. include checklist in runbook.
sam_sre: add tracing span "admission.enqueue" and carry traceparent through slot_token so we can correlate enqueue->dispatch in traces.
akash_k: prototype plan: simple probabilistic router + dedupe warmup; bench target shim latency <500ns for resident path. will attach bench numbers to RFC follow-up.
maria_r: API sketch for docs:
POST /v1/admit
body: { model: string, token_count: int, urgency?: "interactive"|"normal"|"low", cache_hint?: "warm"|"none", policy_id?: string }
resp: { enqueued: true|false, slot_token?: string, queue_tag: string, expected_wait_ms_est: int }
linh_t: rename latency_hint->urgency in docs to avoid confusing product UX hints.
maria_r: agree. ops: include a cost dashboard showing delta for fastpath vs packed. + a throttling knob for warmups.
sam_sre: add alert if warmup_dropped > warmup_attempts * 0.9 over 5m. also alert if fastpath_cost_usd spikes > baseline * 2 for 10m.
maria_r: action items: i'll draft the RFC follow-up with telemetry table, rollout checklist, and runbook appendix. akash will prototype the shim + harness. sam will own dashboards/alerts. devops_j will wire FFs. ops-bot: feature-flag ff/queue-ecosystem-v1 created in staging.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: ff/queue-ecosystem-v1 created in staging.
akash_k: i'll post initial bench numbers + a small sim run tomorrow.
maria_r: thanks all, please review the follow-up when i post. :thumbsup:
